column3: The Kirby Industrial Mortgage Loan (9.3%), for which Citi Real Estate Funding Inc. and Argentic Real Estate Finance 2 LLC are the mortgage loan sellers, is part of a Whole Loan that was co-originated by Citi Real Estate Funding Inc. and Argentic Real Estate Finance 2 LLC. Such Mortgage Loan was underwritten pursuant to Citi Real Estate Funding Inc.’s and Argentic Real Estate Finance 2 LLC’s underwriting guidelines.
